description: GDROM-derived operating rules cover more than 450 reservoirs in the contiguous United States. The deposit combines processed daily operation records and reservoir-specific if-then rules, with most records longer than fifteen years. This resource is provided by Donghui Li; Yanan Chen; Ximing Cai and coauthors. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: This resource is shared under the Creative Commons Attribution CC BY.. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: Rules are learned from processed historical observations, not official operating manuals. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
